customSections.label: OUSD Family Planning Notes
customSections.content: Some OUSD schedules and deadlines fall outside the main student calendar.

groups.label: Schedules outside the district calendar
items: Transportation registration for 2026–27 was due July 5, 2026. OUSD says routing for late registrations may take up to 10 business days after school starts.
Bell schedules, minimum days, orientations, and school events should be checked on the individual school site or in ParentSquare.
Summer Learning and Expanded Learning programs publish schedules separately from the regular district calendar.

customSections.label: OUSD Calendar Types and Programs
customSections.content: Most OUSD students follow the district calendar, but some schools and programs use different schedules.

groups.label: When to check another calendar
items: Alternative education high schools may use different grading calendars.
Child Development Centers and early childhood programs may use different hours or remain open during some district breaks.
Independent study and adult education students should confirm program-specific dates.
Charter and independently operated schools in Oakland may publish calendars that do not follow OUSD district dates.

customSections.label: Three-Year OUSD Calendar History
customSections.content: Recent OUSD calendars show why families should verify each school year rather than reusing prior-year dates. The 2025–26 comparison above uses OUSD’s January 2025 board announcement; the 2027–28 dates use the calendar linked from OUSD’s current district calendar page.

groups.label: 2025–26 through 2027–28

2027–28: August 9, 2027 to May 24, 2028; Spring Break is April 3–7.

calendarFaqs.q: When did OUSD start school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: OUSD students started the 2026–27 school year on Monday, August 10, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for OUSD in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of instruction for Oakland Unified is Thursday, May 27, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is OUSD Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: OUSD Spring Break runs Monday, March 29 through Friday, April 2, 2027. Students return Monday, April 5.

calendarFaqs.q: When is OUSD Winter Break, and when do students return?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 21, 2026 through January 4, 2027. January 5 is a professional development day with no school for students, so classes resume Wednesday, January 6.

calendarFaqs.q: Which OUSD professional development days are no-school days?
calendarFaqs.a: September 18, 2026 and January 5, 2027 are professional development days with no school for students.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the OUSD calendar apply to charter schools?
calendarFaqs.a: Not necessarily. Charter and independently operated schools in Oakland may publish their own calendars, so families should check the individual school calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: Do OUSD Child Development Centers follow the same school breaks?
calendarFaqs.a: Not always. OUSD notes that some Child Development Centers remain open during Thanksgiving, Winter, and Spring Break. Families should confirm the schedule with their center.
Yes. Check the official OUSD district calendar page and school communications before making fixed travel, childcare, or transportation plans.

whatsNew.title: What Changed from 2025–26
content: The school year started August 10, one day earlier than in 2025–26.
The last day is May 27, one day earlier than in 2025–26.
Spring Break is March 29–April 2, one week earlier than the 2025–26 break.
Farmworkers Day (in lieu) falls on March 26, immediately before Spring Break.
